tokens.raw: The Continue portal of the main menu has a `load` popup tab. `setContinuePortal` only adds its vortex and popup while saves are listed. The menu sequence updates it when summaries finish loading after the menu was generated, or when the last save is erased. Confirming a save runs `initiateLoad`, which plays the first half of a warp: the hero steps into the portal and vision closes. After the loading screen appears, the World component restores the world, installs systems and switches to it. The restored world continues exactly as it was saved, without the vision opening of a new world. Children of the World component remount for the new world, and the camera starts at the restored viewpoint.
